findings.claim: Q3 2026 營收年增 20% 至 $2.08B；產品營收年增 37% 至 $765M；服務營收年增 13% 至 $1.31B；billings 年增 29% 至 $2.34B
findings.excerpt: Product revenue increased 37% and 43% during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: 10-Q 稱產品營收成長主因硬體平均售價提高，及高效能安全網路產品與 AI 基礎設施部署需求；總毛利率因產品占比上升下降 1.8pp（Q3）
findings.excerpt: Total gross margin decreased 1.8 and 1.0 percentage points during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: 服務營收成長 13%，管理層稱受大型企業部署時點影響，大型協議可能合併既有服務安排
findings.excerpt: While service revenue grew 13%, management said the result was affected by timing related to large enterprise deployments.

findings.claim: FY2026 營收指引 $8.125B–$8.215B，billings 指引年內第三度上調
findings.excerpt: Revenue in the range of $8.125 billion to $8.215 billion

findings.claim: Gartner 2026 資安支出約 $246.2B、成長 12.2%（固定匯率）；網路安全設備 2026 預測上修 $1.7B（次級部落格轉述）
findings.excerpt: Gartner’s $246.2B Security Forecast shows 10 categories growing 2x to 3x the market
